name: cardinal-benchmark
description: Cardinal Benchmark evaluates OCR and document-layout recognition performance on real-world scanned/document images, measuring how well models transcribe text and preserve layout information. It is intended to benchmark end-to-end optical character recognition and related document understanding tasks across varied conditions. The dataset supports evaluation of recognition accuracy under realistic noise and layout variations.
reputation: A domain-specific OCR/document-understanding benchmark with modest adoption in document-AI research communities compared to larger OCR corpora.
